item.title: Izu Cycling: The Nishi Izu Skyline Ridge Road — Guide
item.description: The Izu Peninsula has become one of Japan’s notable cycling destinations, its roads having hosted Olympic cycling events, and the Nishi Izu Skyline is among its most rewarding rides: a ridge-top road winding along the mountains of western Izu with sweeping views over Suruga Bay toward Mount Fuji on clear days. The climbs are genuine and the descents long, making it a route best suited to reasonably fit road cyclists, while drivers and motorcyclists enjoy the same panoramas from the frequent lookouts.
